why: The liveness check dropped, so the reaper collects EVERY pid-named worker worktree it finds -- including the ones a mutate run happening right now is using. It then deletes a running job's working directory mid-mutation, which is far worse than the residue this reaper exists to remove: the victim's next `git` or file read fails from a directory that no longer exists, with nothing in its own output explaining why. Silent on a machine running one sweep at a time, which is most of them, so the harness looks fine until the day it does real damage.
killedBy: staleWorkerWorktrees: collecting a killed run's leftovers (issue #664) LEAVES a live run's worktrees alone -- the property that makes this safe to run
